services.name: Shark Fishing
services.desc: We love the chance to introduce kids of all ages and skill to the joy of fishing. A in-shore and shark fishing trip is the perfect way to get children interested in fishing, experiencing the outdoors, and develop a love for nature. We always have all the safety gear and our boat is a clean and safe environment for all

includes: Tackle, bait, fuel, cooler, ice, bottled water
gap: Exact prices for each trip duration not stated
blurb: Reel Job Charter Fishing offers guided fishing trips on Hilton Head Island targeting species like redfish, cobia, trout, sharks, and more. Trips are family-friendly and suitable for all experience levels, including children ages 4 and up. They provide all gear, licenses, bait, and expertise for an all-inclusive fishing experience.
extraNote: Cancellations must be made at least 24 hours in advance for refund · No refunds within 24 hours or for no-shows · Broad Creek Marina, Hilton Head Island, SC
